2025 / IEEE SMC / Conference paper

A Black-Box Positioning Solution for Effortless Integration in Wearable Navigation

Anh-Van Vu, Changmin Sung, Dongsoo Han

2025 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (SMC) · pp. 5762–5769

Conference paper published in 2025; author manuscript deposited on arXiv in October 2026.

Publisher / DOIOpen manuscript

Overview

Presents PDRS, a self-contained inertial positioning module that performs real-time sensor fusion on an embedded processor and provides position estimates through I²C, SPI, and UART. Hardware–software co-design simplifies integration into low-power wearable and IoT platforms.
